newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey details capitalisation award terms.
newsitem.headline: Plessey details capitalisation award terms.

text.p: Plessey Corp Ltd Ltd said on Monday that shareholders registered in the firm's books on June 27 will receive capitalisation shares.

It said that the ratio of the award will be based on the weighted average of the traded prices of the shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for the three days ending July 24. This will then be discounted by a factor of six percent to five rise to the ordinary issue price.
Shareholders were reminded that they may decline the award instead renouncing their entitlement to Coronation Asset Management (Pty) Ltd for a cash payment of 13.0 cents per share.
